introHtml: Popl apparel accessories combine the utility of custom gear with instant digital connectivity. These branded items, like Popl hats and lanyards, allow wearers to share contact info or social links with a simple tap, making them ideal for trade shows and networking events. Choose from a variety of styles and colors to match your brand identity, and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish that keeps your brand top of mind.
